editorial.name: Fold
editorial.descriptionZh: 印度的个人记账 App 官网，靠政府监管的 Account Aggregator 框架连银行账户，自动拉取并分类支出，还做账单分享和现金流洞察。
editorial.takeawayZh: 看记账 App 怎么用复式记账的行话做文案
editorial.noteZh: 整页浅灰带纸纹，左上角一个黑色半月形 fold 标，左下角一颗二维码，右上一列胶囊按钮 Team / Manifesto / Blog / Privacy。首屏大字 Be 😜 painfully aware.，配一句 Fold securely connects to your Bank accounts and gives a clear picture of your finances.，底下小字标着 Currently in public beta，并说明连接走 Government regulated Account Aggregator Framework、要 OTP。往下 Stop recording expenses manually. 一段直接写 No Email scraping / No SMS scraping；More than a row in a spreadsheet. 展示一个能搜 Coffee、按 TODAY / THIS MONTH / THIS WEEK 筛选、带 INCOMING / OUTGOING / TAGS 的界面，配一句 Just type in McDonald's for example and see all the times you have spent at McDonald's.；再往后是 Inform & Delight.、Never visit your Bank's website again.、OUR GOAL To separate anxiety from money.、Our approach to Privacy.。

reasons.statement: 这是 Fold 自家记账 App 的官网首页，来源是落地页灵感目录 saaslandingpage.com；页面动作只有下载 App 和读 Manifesto，价值在整站那种不客气的文案语气与排版，因此归产品与公司官网。
页面上没有可复制或下载的设计资产，站内路径只有 /team、/blog、/love 三条，是单产品的品牌展示站。

pages.title: Manage your money with Fold
